comparison.objective: Route a fibre cord around a guide and seat its connector without violating bend radius; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable routing, bend control, and connector seating versus rigid precision tooling, bimanual impact control, and fragment search and retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Cord follows the guide, never bends below 25 mm radius, connector is seated, and hands release; candidate requires four safe fractures and all tangs deposited.
comparison.reason: The principal tested physics—continuous flexible-object curvature versus contact-driven rigid fracture—are meaningfully different.
